items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We had such a ball! The DeMarco Sisters - what was that guy's name, Stan something, a very funny guy - [INTERVIEWEE] A comedian that did all the parts.

ctx.x: We closed in Boston because at the time, I think it was June or July, because I have a record that when I came into the Birdland with Tony Bennett and some more peoples and I was supposed to play with Basie's band at that particular time, I sat in the audience and I did not play in the band because I had to leave.
We had such a ball! The DeMarco Sisters - what was that guy's name, Stan something, a very funny guy -

A comedian that did all the parts. Then you remember that Jackie would always say, "Milt, didn't you fix the coffee?" and if he didn't get that coffee, that was it. Jackie at that particular time had a weight problem.
